checkpoints.description: [1/5] Build a stdlib-only Phase 2 CNS/BBB property screening pipeline: contract, rules, ranking, CLI, tests, docs.

impact_assessment.why: Phase 2 needs a reproducible triage step before docking; the repository currently holds only prose protocols.
impact_assessment.benefits: Turns the BBB/CNS criteria into an executable, tested filter and gives every subsequent docking run a consistent candidate set.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CSV schema and tier vocabulary; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: file outputs use temp+replace; state: no persisted state beyond generated reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze the contract in docs and ADR-001, cover boundaries with unit tests, and keep generated outputs opt-in via --out/--json.

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Verification: 28 tests pass; PNN gates 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed.
[4/4] Review: rejected non-finite/negative/fractional inputs, unknown charge to UNKNOWN, atomic temp cleanup, full output columns; 32 tests pass; checklists: passed.
[1/5] Add a docking-result consensus ranker: CSV contract, normalized multi-target scoring, screening-tier join, CLI, tests and docs.

impact_assessment.why: Phase 2 property triage now produces candidates, but the documented Vina/Glide/MM-GBSA consensus workflow has no executable aggregation step.
impact_assessment.benefits: Turns heterogeneous per-target docking outputs into one transparent, reproducible shortlist and prevents ranking by raw scores from incomparable engines.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new docking CSV and shortlist schema; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: reports are written atomically; state: no persisted state beyond generated reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Document the contract and normalization limits, require Vina as the primary score, expose coverage, and cover normalization, filters and joins with tests.

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Verification: 52 tests pass; rank and screen help under 200ms; PNN gates 4/4; checklists: passed.
[1/5] Add a compound-library curation CLI: provenance-aware merge, ID/SMILES deduplication, tier filtering, property-space binning, caps, tests and docs.

impact_assessment.why: Phase 2 needs a reproducible way to merge vendor and repurposing libraries into a defined 50K-200K screening set without duplicates or property-space clumps.
impact_assessment.benefits: Produces a traceable curated library from multiple sources and keeps the docking budget focused on diverse, tier-qualified compounds.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new curated CSV schema; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: atomic report writes; state: no persisted state beyond generated reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate ID collisions, document exact-SMILES limits and binning semantics, expose every removal count in JSON, and cover merge, dedupe, filter and cap boundaries with tests.

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Verification: 66 tests pass; curate help under 200ms; PNN gates 4/4; checklists: passed.
